verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Word, Excel and PowerPoint files convert without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice. Excel, OpenDocument and CSV sheets convert to PDF with Excel-like page fitting or into each other, DOCX converts to HWPX with layout preserved, and PDFs convert back into Word or PowerPoint, with multi-step routes found automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Word→PDF and PowerPoint→PDF output and of Word/PowerPoint↔OpenDocument conversion, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of conversion fidelity.
